coaching.headline: We took Orb Prime at 29 and lost the base by 32.7: the fight at 31.7, lost 1-4 at our inhibitor, threw it.
coaching.team: We lost a game we had won at 29. The early map was conceded: Fangtooth at 8 and Mini Prime at 12 both went to them, the second right after Renna, Sevarog and Murdock died 0-3 to Mourn and Morigesh at their Mini Prime with Revenant stuck in a losing lane. Solo deaths kept feeding: six of ours caught alone, three of them Renna; the Fangtooth at 21 fell with Revenant, Dekker and Renna dead, and the one at 26 with Revenant dead. Then the game turned: Renna, Murdock and Revenant won 4-0 at our inner tower at 27.8 and we cashed it into Genesis Core and Orb Prime. With Orb Prime on us and 16 items to their 15, the fight at 31.7 at our inhibitor went 1-4 with Sevarog credited nowhere in it, and the inhibitor and core fell inside a minute. We out-warded them 44 to 29; they out-healed us, Mourn alone at 24,653, against our three anti-heal items. Next game: when Orb Prime is ours, the five push together or nobody fights.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Two fights. The one at 10.5, three of ours dead to two of them at their Mini Prime, handed over the early map. The one at 31.7, lost 1-4 at our inhibitor with Orb Prime on us and the jungler credited nowhere, handed over the base.
coaching.whatWorked: The fight at 27.8: Renna, Murdock and Revenant went 4-0 at our inner tower and it was turned into Genesis Core and Orb Prime inside two minutes.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock was the damage and six of the deaths. 39,897 hero damage, the most on either side, 5 kills, 11 wards. Caught alone by Muriel at 21.3 right before an outer tower fell, and part of the fight at 10.5, lost 0-3 at their Mini Prime.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Sevarog soaked, then went uncredited. 69,083 damage taken, the most in the game, and 63,525 mitigated, 4 kills on 3 deaths. But no kill or death credited in four of the last six fights, including the one at 31.7 that lost the base; whether he was in them is not provable from the feed, so the note is the call: with Orb Prime on us, five push together or nobody fights.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Renna was caught alone three times and two of them opened an objective: solo deaths to Mourn at 18.8 and Morigesh twice after, one right before an outer tower fell and one right before Fangtooth at 25.8 and a 4v5 we lost. 3 kills, 6 deaths, 4 wards.
perPlayer.32929f48-80dd-4979-be2c-3269d2dcd137: Revenant took first blood on Wraith at 5.4 and gave it straight back, caught alone by Wraith at 6.8 with Fangtooth falling a minute later. 4 kills, 5 deaths, in a lane that read theirs all game; alive but pinned when three of ours died at their Mini Prime, which made that the wrong fight to start.
perPlayer.e2c1a9e4-1734-410a-b61a-0aa396a93930: Dekker did the vision job: 17 wards placed, the most on either side, and 9 of 17 team kills. The solo death to Muriel at 13.2 is the one to own; the other four came inside fights, and three of those fights were lost.

e2c1a9e4-1734-410a-b61a-0aa396a93930.text: Seventeen wards and 9 of 17 team kills is the support job; the solo death at 13.2 is the fix.

20.call: Revenant and Dekker died 0-2 at their Fangtooth with Murdock alive and ahead in lane and Sevarog alive with no kill or death credited; Fangtooth fell at 20.8. Two alone there is a pick, not a fight: the other three come or both leave.

10.5.call: Three of ours walked to their Mini Prime and died 0-3 to two of them with Revenant pinned in a losing lane; Mini Prime followed at 11.6. With the carry losing and nothing up, this fight is not taken.

25.4.call: Opened 4v5 with Renna dead 37 seconds earlier and lost 1-3; Fangtooth at 25.8 and two outer towers followed. The call is no fight at all: Renna was dead, Sevarog alive with no kill or death credited, and nothing there was worth a 4v5.

27.8.call: Renna, Murdock and Revenant went 4-0 at our inner tower and the team took Genesis Core and Orb Prime off it. Right fight, right follow-up. That is the whole game plan in one sequence; the next fight ignored it.

31.7.call: Orb Prime on us, 16 items to their 15, and the fight was taken at our inhibitor, lost 1-4, with Sevarog credited nowhere; the inhibitor fell at 32, the core at 32.7. With Orb Prime, five push together.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Tainted Rounds in Lightning Hawk's slot was the right swap into Mourn and Muriel's healing (Mourn healed 24,653), and 39,897 hero damage says the trade cost nothing; the six deaths came from the fights taken and the solo catch at 21.3, and the items had no part in them.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Vermis pays out on every third straight basic attack on the same hero, which fits Murdock's stand-and-shoot poke into Mourn's frontline, and gives up the item scaling Demiurge would give a four-item build.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Inquisition and Orb Of Growth in Flux Matrix's slot bought damage and mana on a tank whose job was to be in the last three fights; 69,083 damage taken says the tankiness was there, and the kill or death credit in four of the last six fights was not.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vesh turns every ability hit into a burn over time, a fit for a Sevarog whose Siphon and root are the damage, and gives up the raw health Krix would add to a tank already soaking 69,083.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: On the full Entropy, Wraith Leggings, Overseer core with Tainted Scepter for anti-heal into Mourn and Muriel; nothing to teach here.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vesh turns every ability hit into a burn over time, the fit for a mage whose kit is zones and waves, at the cost of any durability against Morigesh's 31,528 magic damage.

32929f48-80dd-4979-be2c-3269d2dcd137.build: Scattershot in Vanquisher's slot traded the execute for spread hits, and Tainted Rounds fourth was the right anti-heal into two healers; none of the lost fights turned on that swap.
32929f48-80dd-4979-be2c-3269d2dcd137.eternal: Vermis pays out on every third straight basic attack on the same hero, which fits Revenant's 1v1 ultimate realm where the target cannot leave, and trades away Demiurge's item scaling.

e2c1a9e4-1734-410a-b61a-0aa396a93930.build: Enra's Blessing in Timewarp's slot on a catch-and-peel support, and no fight in the game turned on it; nothing to teach here.
e2c1a9e4-1734-410a-b61a-0aa396a93930.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals, so there is no loadout read for Dekker.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn, Muriel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 magical — one magic-resist item goes a long way.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
ourKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
ourKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
ourKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

ourKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
ourKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
ourKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
ourKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

ourKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
ourKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Mark a target → Hive slow → Swarm reposition → Curse execute-burst ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Mark + Curse a squishy and delete them with %max-HP Pestilence
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds her marked target
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's squishy with one escape (Swarm) — dive after it's used; spread vs Hive

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

enemyKits.combo: Alacrity shield+AS → Consecrated Ground bubble → Reversal global save
enemyKits.winCondition: keep the carry alive with global shields and enable their damage
enemyKits.passive: abilities grant Sentinel to allies; on-hit bonus
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has no damage threat — dive her carry through the shields or pick her first

loadout.name: Nightmare Extractor
loadout.text: Casting an Ability reduces the Cooldown of Extract by 20%.

ability.name: Extract
ability.what: Mourn's next basic attack will deal an additional 20/28/36/44/52/60/68/76/84/92/100/108/116/124/132/140/148/156 (+50%)(+90%)(+6% ) magical damage to all targets hit.

loadout.plain: Every ability cast brings your empowered Extract attack back sooner. Weave Contagion, Abduct and Beguile with basic attacks for more healing hits.

loadout.name: Nihil
loadout.text: Damage a hero to gain Doom for 3s. Doom grants 1 Physical Power, 2 Magical Power, 1 Physical Armor & 1 Magical Armor for every 3s it persists. On level-up or Takedown, the stats Doom grants are permanently increased by 20%.
loadout.plain: Staying in fights with heroes builds up power and armor over time, and level-ups or takedowns make it permanently stronger. Fits Mourn's long brawls.

loadout.name: From the Abyss
loadout.text: Restore 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health/s (Levels 1/6/11/16) while in Hero Combat or out of enemy vision.
loadout.plain: Heals a share of your max health every second while fighting heroes or hidden, on top of Extract and Contagion healing.

loadout.name: Adaptive Plating
loadout.text: Taking damage grants matching Armor (1% per hit, stacks 10x).
loadout.plain: Getting hit gives you armor of the matching type. Helps you survive charging Beguile in the middle of the enemy team.

loadout.name: Saphir's Mantle
loadout.text: Atlas:  Increase your Size and Max Health by 10% for 6s. Deal 60 (+1.25%) Damage to nearby Heroes. After the duration, permanently increase your Max Health by 20% of the Damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Briefly grows your health and size and damages nearby heroes, then keeps part of that as permanent health. Pop it during a Beguile channel in the middle of the enemy team.
